ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast with approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels distributed distally and 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated centrally and along the trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches on the distal half of both lobes. Significant black mottling and fine linear streaking intersect these white regions. Central peduncle connection and median area are uniformly low-intensity (dark).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Asymmetric U-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 40 degrees; depth is moderate with irregular jagged boundaries within the notch apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge. Distal tips exhibit more pronounced, irregular jaggedness compared to the inner margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the outer trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to pointed, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, low-intensity circular spots (dark on white) clustered near the leading edge of the left lobe and the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of linear pixel disruptions. Right lobe features a prominent, high-contrast 'X' shaped mark. Left lobe displays multiple parallel diagonal dark streaks across the white pigment field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct intersecting pair of linear scars (cross-shape) on the upper right lobe. Multiple deep, irregular indentations along the trailing edge that deviate from a smooth biological curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-hatched scarring pattern on the right lobe white field serves as a primary high-contrast identifier.
